activation_correlations_calendar.query:
SELECT count() people, countIf(onboard_done_day0) finished_day0, countIf(breathed_day0) breathed_day0_count, countIf(purchased_day0) purchased_day0_count, countIf(returned_week1) returned_week1_count,
countIf(breathed_day0 AND returned_week1) breathed_and_returned, countIf(NOT breathed_day0 AND returned_week1) no_breath_and_returned,
countIf(onboard_done_day0 AND returned_week1) finished_and_returned,
countIf(purchased_day0 AND returned_week1) purchased_and_returned,
countIf(dailies_day0) dailies_day0_count,countIf(dailies_day0 AND returned_week1) dailies_and_returned
FROM (
SELECT first_onboard,
arrayExists(x -> x.2='onboarding_completed' AND x.1>=first_onboard AND toDate(x.1)=toDate(first_onboard), activity) onboard_done_day0,
arrayExists(x -> x.2='exercise_session_completed' AND x.1>=first_onboard AND toDate(x.1)=toDate(first_onboard), activity) breathed_day0,
arrayExists(x -> x.2='paywall_purchase_completed' AND x.1>=first_onboard AND toDate(x.1)=toDate(first_onboard), activity) purchased_day0,
arrayExists(x -> x.2='dailies_completed' AND x.1>=first_onboard AND toDate(x.1)=toDate(first_onboard), activity) dailies_day0,
arrayExists(x -> x.2='screen_view' AND dateDiff('day',first_onboard,x.1)>=1 AND dateDiff('day',first_onboard,x.1)<=7, activity) returned_week1
FROM (
SELECT person_id,minIf(timestamp,event='onboarding_started') first_onboard,groupArray(tuple(timestamp,event)) activity
FROM events WHERE timestamp>='2026-04-24' AND timestamp<'2026-10-09' AND event IN ('onboarding_started','onboarding_completed','exercise_session_completed','paywall_purchase_completed','dailies_completed','screen_view') AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_emulator), 'false') != 'true' AND coalesce(toString(properties.analytics_env), 'production') NOT IN ('development','preview') AND person_id NOT IN ('cf13f472-3448-5c61-90eb-0934cbeb129a','148376be-4fe6-5e90-98a0-96e45106a9a4','c9fe2906-b406-5a1c-aa51-3ad762c411aa')
GROUP BY person_id HAVING countIf(event='onboarding_started')>0)
WHERE first_onboard>='2026-09-09' AND first_onboard<'2026-10-02'
)
